newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Semicon sees '97 sales at 3 trln won.
newsitem.headline: LG Semicon sees '97 sales at 3 trln won.

text.p: LG Semicon Co, one of South Korea's top three chipmakers, has set its sales target for calendar 1997 at three trillion won, compared with about 2.2 trillion won estimated for 1996, a company spokesman said on Monday.
LG Semicon's spokesman Han Dong-mun said the company also planned to invest about 2.3 trillion won this year, unchanged from 1996.

Han said this year's major investment projects would include the expansion of production capacity for 64-megabit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips and the construction of a multimedia chip plant in Britain.
The company plans to start mass producing the 64-megabit chip from between February and March at a rate of about 100,000 units per month, he said.
The monthly output will increase gradually to about one million units per month by the end of June, he said.
